UNESCO warns Pakistan over Taxila heritage site conservation methods

UNESCO has issued a warning to Pakistan regarding the conservation of its ancient Taxila heritage sites. The organization has formally requested Pakistan to reverse recent interventions, including the use of cement, at the Mohra Moradu and Sirkap sites. This action raises concerns about the authenticity and preservation of these historical locations.
